title: UI Gallery Code Editor Canvas Paint Tail Attribution v1
problem: Fresh UI Gallery code-editor resize-jitter evidence shows the current worst frame is dominated by a Canvas paint tail, while ViewCache is not the top layout owner. This lane attributes that Canvas tail before any code-editor, windowed-rows-surface, diagnostics, or renderer runtime change.

repro.summary: Reuse the VCRJ-030 UI Gallery code-editor resize-jitter bundle as starting evidence, then rerun the same script after source attribution if the Canvas paint tail needs confirmation.
commands: target/release/fretboard-dev diag perf tools/diag-scripts/ui-gallery/code-editor/ui-gallery-code-editor-window-resize-drag-jitter-steady.json --repeat 1 --warmup-frames 5 --reuse-launch --prewarm-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prewarm-fonts.json --prelude-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prelude-reset-diagnostics.json --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE=1 --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE_SHELL=1 --env FRET_DIAG_RENDERER_PERF=1 --env FRET_LAYOUT_NODE_PROFILE=1 --env FRET_LAYOUT_NODE_PROFILE_TOP=20 --env FRET_LAYOUT_NODE_PROFILE_MIN_US=1 --env FRET_DIAG_SCRIPT_AUTO_DUMP=0 --env FRET_DIAG_SEMANTICS=0 --dir target/fret-diag/ui-gallery-code-editor-canvas-paint-tail-attribution-v1-cpt030 --launch -- cargo run -p fret-ui-gallery --release --features gallery-full
